notes: family: point-salad-euro. Base-game scoring verified against the official revised rulebook: four floors of five rooms, worth 1/2/3/4 VP per occupied room; 1 VP per leftover krone and kitchen item; -5 VP per guest in the cafe. Enter track VP after round 7 Emperor scoring but before final scoring. Items on guest cards do not score as kitchen leftovers. Equal VP is broken by combined leftover krones and kitchen items; if still equal, no further official tiebreaker is specified. The deluxe slug is retained for compatibility, but Deluxe/Let's Waltz modules and solo scoring are not verified or modelled.
